page.layout: One block: a title page, centred. Printed lines from top to bottom, all in one column; no margins, no running head, no page number.
page.notes: Title page. Letters are in large spaced capitals for VERA, METHODUS, TRACTATUS and in small capitals for the rest; the lines are transcribed as printed. The faint grey stamp at the lower right corner is a digitiser's mark and is left out. Stains and show-through are omitted.
